tasks.label: Check push env presence only
args: const fs=require('node:fs');const file='web/.env.local';if(!fs.existsSync(file)){console.log('web/.env.local: missing');process.exit(0)}const contents=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');for(const key of ['NEXT_PUBLIC_ONESIGNAL_APP_ID','ONESIGNAL_REST_API_KEY','NOTIFY_SECRET','CRON_SECRET','SITE_URL','API_URL','API_SHARED_SECRET']){const match=contents.match(new RegExp('^\\s*'+key+'\\s*=\\s*(.*?)\\s*$','m'));const value=match?.[1]?.replace(/^['\"]|['\"]$/g,'').trim();console.log(key+': '+(value?'present':'missing or empty'))}
